categories.headline: Weakest area: trust signals (2/5).

findings.title: Blocking shipping modal hides the hero on first load
findings.evidence: A white 'Where are we shipping to?' modal sits in the center of the viewport. A dark overlay dims the hero image, headline and nav. The country is already set to 'United States', so the modal asks the user to confirm something that was already detected. The only exits are a small X and the CONFIRM button.
findings.fix: Replace the modal with a non-blocking top banner or a footer country selector, and show it only when the detected region differs from the store's. If a modal stays, make it dismissible by clicking outside it and remember the choice.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Hero headline and CTAs have weak contrast and are visually buried
findings.evidence: The 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' headline is in light gray-beige over a busy gravel and shoe photo, bottom right, and is hard to read. 'ALL NEW DASHER NZ COLLECTION' is a tiny, low-contrast monospace eyebrow. The SHOP MEN and SHOP WOMEN pills are small gray buttons that blend into the photo. The vertical 'DASHER NZ' text adds clutter.
findings.fix: Add a gradient scrim or solid panel behind the text. Increase the headline size and weight. Use high-contrast filled primary CTAs, such as dark buttons with white text. Drop the vertical text or reduce it.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Few trust signals and a generic promo bar
findings.evidence: The only message above the fold is 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' in a thin top bar. There are no visible reviews, ratings, returns policy, or sustainability certification. The 'Shop Best Sellers' floating chip is faded behind the overlay and the color tiles below are empty.
findings.fix: Add a trust strip under the hero with a star rating and review count, a free returns or guarantee note, and B Corp or carbon footprint badges. Make the best-sellers chip clearly visible.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.
